author: OrnaOdie
body:
As stated a few times now - Legendary Sprite Packs have allowed us to keep up with the increased cost of running a game in this climate without resorting to Ads or P2W.

If you find them to be too expensive for your liking, you can simply not purchase them. Going this route will not impact your playstyle.

However, I do imagine Ads or P2W would impact your playstyle - would that be something you would have preferred?

author: MeijiHKitty
body:
I mean I feel like $10 for a pack is reasonable, you’re getting usually 12+ sprites (even if you end up only using one from it). The higher priced ones you get 4 or 5 that are animated, and it takes time to do animations. Whether it’s worth $30 for those animations is debatable and subjective

Since these are purely cosmetic, it’s not like they give you a special edge by using them or forces you to purchase them in order to progress. They are meant to support the game’s development while also giving the community customization to your character, they have no affect on gameplay

The game is F2P and not P2W, so I am alright with the cosmetics costing a bit more in order to upkeep the game and have more content produced rather than have P2W aspects added and funding the game instead

It’s also at least guaranteed sprites vs having them paywalled behind gacha rolls where there’s a CHANCE of getting them mixed in with useless items, and end up with nothing (and usually even if you get one it’s a random one you didn’t want, not the one you wanted). Gacha are true money grabs lol

author: Ttoctam
body:
You do not have to buy sprites if you do not want to. It's an entirely optional aspect of this free and ad-less game. A team of people have to work a full time job to keep this game running updating and improving, and on top of that they need to pay for servers, ads, and more. 

You buying one of these sprite packs is less than one hour's work's wage for one of them.

I'm still using the earth day sprite I unlocked purely through gameplay without paying a cent. Plus you can unlock sprites through all the guilds, or pick up non-temp sprites for a few bucks.

author: Oulanos65
body:
I really hate being that guy but I agree with Odie on that one, there’s absolutely nothing condescending in his answers and completely right about if we don’t like it we don’t buy it. That said, I also would love to see those at 19.99 instead of 29.99 of course, I may/would purchase or of them but I’m sure a marketing test was done to give us those numbers today. 

If I were picky, I would really love to see the sprite advert being moved somewhere else than the « main event » panel as to me it’s not the event itself, it’s the cosmetic side of it. I understand it’s a way to remind people they can purchase the sprites but on months like this month there are a lot of sprites at the same time and it makes it a bit more difficult to know what is active and what not. Maybe another tab on top of the event panel? Don’t know.

author: thegreenmonkey69
body:
I've bought standard sprite packs and they are decent enough that i.like them. Theyve even improved somewhat over the past year or so. I may even by one of the animated packs, but still on the fence.

That being said, since installed playing this game 4 or 5 years ago, the graphics have improved immensely. If purchasing a sprite pack at 29.99 is what makes that keep happening I will gladly lay down the cash for it. Because I hate, hate, hate ads and p2w/p2p games.

Orna had been quite fun, and frustrating at times but it has always been enjoyable. As a free game with a purely optional cosmetice purchase system it has been one of the better games inhave run into.

Keep up the good work.
